newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chirac, Juppe popularity ratings slip further.
newsitem.headline: Chirac, Juppe popularity ratings slip further.

text.p: The popularity ratings of French President Jacques Chirac and Prime Minister Alain Juppe have sunk further, with only 27 and 20 percent of voters respectively satisfied with their performance, a poll said on Sunday.

The IFOP survey for the weekly Le Journal du Dimanche showed Chirac losing one percentage point compared to the previous month. The percentage of those dissatisfied with the president fell from 61 to 58 percent.

Juppe's popularity rating also dropped one percent from last month's 21 percent who were satisfied with him. Sixty-eight percent, against last month's 69 percent, said they were dissatisfied with him.
Juppe is blamed for record unemployment, a sluggish economy and the effects of austerity policies aimed at helping France qualify for a single European currency.
